sloka: नचास्य भविता कश्चित्सदृशः शास्त्रदर्शने ।वरुणश्च वरं प्रादान्नास्य मृत्युर्भविष्यति ।वर्षायुतशतेनापि मत्पाशादुदकादपि ।। ७.३६.१५ ॥
transliteration: nacāsya bhavitā kaścitsadṛśaḥ śāstradarśane ।varuṇaśca varaṁ prādānnāsya mṛtyurbhaviṣyati ।varṣāyutaśatenāpi matpāśādudakādapi ।। 7.36.15 ॥

translations.english: No one will be his equal in understanding scriptures, and Varuna also granted a boon that his death will not occur even by a hundred thousand years of water, nor from Varuna's noose or from water itself.
